description: This file contains core functions and driver code for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) component specific to the AR9 platform, including hardware initialization, firmware download, and register access functions.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_get_fw_ver
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version major and minor numbers.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes hardware components and resets the chip.

methods.name: ifx_pp32_start
methods.description: Downloads firmware and starts the PP32 processor.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_proc_read_regs
methods.description: Reads and outputs current register states for debugging.
